goal.vi: Bắt chuyện với người lạ ở sự kiện, hỏi thêm để giữ câu chuyện, rời đi lịch sự và giữ liên lạc.
goal.en: Start a chat with a stranger at an event, keep it going, leave politely and stay in contact.

dialogue.aRole: a guest at a work event
lines: Hi, I'm Kim. Is this your first time at one of these events?
No, my third. What brings you here today?
I'm looking for new ideas for my business. What are you working on these days?
I'm building an app for small farms.
Oh, interesting! How did you get into that?
My family has a farm. Great talk this morning, wasn't it?
It was! Here's my card. Feel free to email me anytime.
It was great talking to you. I'm going to grab some food.

phrases.say: Is this your first time at one of these events?

mean.vi: Bắt chuyện với người lạ ở sự kiện
mean.en: Start talking to a stranger at an event

why.vi: Cách mở đầu dễ và thân thiện ở mọi sự kiện.
why.en: An easy, friendly way to start at any event.

phrases.say: So, what brings you here today?

mean.vi: Hỏi lý do người kia đến sự kiện
mean.en: Ask why someone came to the event

why.vi: "Why are you here?" có thể nghe thô; câu này nghe tò mò, thân thiện.
why.en: "Why are you here?" can sound rude; this sounds curious.

phrases.say: What are you working on these days?

mean.vi: Hỏi về công việc một cách cởi mở
mean.en: Ask about someone's work in an open way

why.vi: Câu này mời người kia kể chuyện, không chỉ nói chức danh.
why.en: This invites a story, not just a job title.

phrases.say: Oh, interesting! How did you get into that?

mean.vi: Hỏi thêm để giữ câu chuyện
mean.en: Ask more to keep the talk going

why.vi: Hỏi tiếp cho thấy bạn thật sự lắng nghe.
why.en: Asking more shows you are really listening.

phrases.say: Great talk this morning, wasn't it?

mean.vi: Bình luận về sự kiện để tìm điểm chung
mean.en: Comment on the event to share something

why.vi: Dùng đuôi hỏi như "wasn't it?", không dùng "no?".
why.en: Use a short question like "wasn't it?", not "no?".

phrases.say: Here's my card. Feel free to email me anytime.
phrases.not: This is my card, you contact me.

mean.vi: Đưa danh thiếp và mời liên lạc
mean.en: Give your card and invite contact

why.vi: "Feel free to…" là lời mời ấm áp, cởi mở.
why.en: "Feel free to…" is a warm, open invitation.

phrases.say: It was great talking to you. I'm going to grab some food.

mean.vi: Rời cuộc trò chuyện lịch sự

why.vi: Đưa lý do thân thiện khi bạn rời cuộc trò chuyện.
why.en: Give a friendly reason when you leave a chat.

ai.name: Ryan
ai.role: a guest at a work event
ai.persona: friendly, a little shy at first
ai.goal: meet new people at the event

roleplay.you: Start a chat with someone at an event, ask about their work, ask one more question, then leave politely and give your contact.

turns.h: Hi, I'm Kim. Is this your first time at one of these events?
br: No, it's my third. What brings you here?

turns.h: Nice to meet you, Ryan. What are you working on these days?
br: I'm building an app for small farms.

turns.a: It's still small, but it's growing.
turns.h: Oh, interesting! How did you get into that?
br: My family has a farm, so I saw the problems.

turns.a: Anyway, I should say hi to a few people.
turns.h: Me too. It was great talking to you. Feel free to email me anytime.

roleplay.end: Enjoy the rest of the event!
